prompt.en: Most Canadians of Asian descent had once been denied the vote. Which group was the last of them to gain it, in 1948?
prompt.fr: La plupart des Canadiens d'origine asiatique s'étaient déjà vu refuser le droit de vote. Quel groupe a été le dernier à l'obtenir, en 1948?

explanation.en: Japanese Canadians were the last group of Canadians of Asian descent to gain the vote, in 1948.
explanation.fr: Les Canadiens d'origine japonaise ont été le dernier groupe de Canadiens d'origine asiatique à obtenir le droit de vote, en 1948.

source.quote: Most Canadians of Asian descent had in the past been denied the vote in federal and provincial elections. In 1948 the last of these, the Japanese- Canadians, gained the right to vote.

verification.evidence: In 1948 the last of these, the Japanese- Canadians, gained the right to vote.
